reviews.text: I've been going to Lincoln Square Animal Hospital since before it was LSAH! The staff is ,and always has been, kind, professional and dedicated. There's a reason I've been bringing my pets here since 2007. They truly care about your pet and your family. It's a very welcoming and caring environment, which is not easy to achieve in a place where you see sick animals all the time. I don't go to one specific doctor, because I have found them all to be knowledgeable, kind, empathetic, and never pushy. They are conscientious of costs, and are never judgemental about your choices. I feel like they love my pets as much as I do, and that's important in their healthcare!

I brought my cat here this morning for litterbox issues. They were able to squeeze me into a cancellation spot at the last minute. I’m so tired from staying up all night with my cat - but the doctor and staff here were lovely, they always have been in the past, and my cat pooped so I am very relieved. Thank you so much! Zonked out gabapentin kitty photo included.

I cannot recommend them. First I don't receive a call back. Then I go o line to book an appointment.  Today is Aug 22, first available appointment September 15. My dog has advanced heart disease waiting that long may not be an option.  Then they demanded payment BEFORE services rendered! I don't even know what's wrong with my dog yet!

They are good professionals and they are nice.

But they are LIARS and CHEATERS

Me and my wife stopped by to ask how much it would cost to neuter our female cat 8 months old.The answer was $350 to $400. When we asked for appointment they said that we had to bring her first for a Puppy Exam. We brought her on 11/09/24, they charged $90 and ‘strongly recommended’ vaccinations for another $147.30. Total charge $237.30.
My wife brought her for the procedure on 11/18/24. No estimate was provided. After the procedure they gave the bill for almost a thousand dollars. My wife was chocked. As well I was. As a truck driver I returned back to Chicago  a few days later and stopped by to discuss their bill. They offered me a lot of bla-bla-bla mostly with their veterinarian terminology and said that my wife was given an Estimate. My wife denied.
They brought an Estimate where my wife signature was FORGED
Dr. Archer does an amazing job with both my ferrets and I highly recommend going to this hospital!
I am so happy I switched to Lincoln Square Animal Hospital! They were so gentle and patient with my almost 18 year old cat.

This place is constantly wrong in big ways. They told us our dog has cancer when she doesn’t and will ask you for additional dollars when you walk out the door. Please DO NOT go here if you care about your animal.

The story:
We went in, recently, to get a mass checked out in my dogs mouth. Immediately they told us it was”looked like cancer” without testing. When we pressed them for a biopsy (which they did), they told us our dog has cancer and she had ~55 days with us. They said we could bring her in for surgery to take off half her jaw, but we were unwilling to put our senior dog through that.

For weeks we were heartbroken, making plans. Then, 55 days came and went with no change in her behavior or habits. The mass had also disappeared. We took her to another vet who did more tests and confirmed SHE DIDNT HAVE CANCER. Shes still with us, today.

There was another time I was charged for services at the end of the appointment. They sent us home with no resolution, but was still charged a premium.

I get a call a few days later telling me I need to call them back to pay additional dollars because the receptionist didn’t key the services in, correctly.

Unprofessional. Money hungry. Uncaring. Don’t know.

While the vet techs here are incredibly kind, other professionals have handled the case with my cat very poorly. Not giving me correct dosage information or ways to collect necessary pain meds, incredibly cold on the phone while giving me bad news about her health, and overall unwelcoming attitude that feels like it’s a burden to care for my animals. Very disappointing and will not ever return, especially after telling me my cat is passing away over the phone with absolutely no sympathy or information.

Our first visit with our senior rescue dog, Walter, and we found the staff very friendly and welcoming. Dr. Wlazlo and Heather, our  Vet Technician were genuinely friendly and knowledgeable. They explained everything they were doing and why, which we appreciated- being fairly new pet parents. A valuable neighborhood resource for pets!

I can't say enough good things about Lincoln Square Animal Hospital! We've been taking our three cats, now approaching senior age, there for three years and love them. From dental cleanings to mass removal surgery, they have always gone above and beyond and provided outstanding care, clear explanations, and wonderful customer service. It gets busy sometimes, but they always get to you as fast as they can and never make you feel rushed. A wonderful, caring staff!

LSAH is the all-time BEST vet! I've been coming here with my dog Lucy for almost 8 years and have never had a bad experience.  They helped us through check ups, broken bones and illness and have always received top-notch care and attention.  I can't say enough about them!  If you're looking for a vet, bring your furry baby here - you will not regret it!

Just moved to the neighborhood. Every single person I met there was incredibly nice. They took great care of my min pin and I will be going back with my border collie after the new year. So far so great
1st off this is the best animal hospital in Chicago! Great service and very polite staff, Eugene and Silva are the best
I've been using them for 16 years. The staff is amazing. The doctors take their time. I've moved 40 minutes away and still drive my babies to them.

Just called to schedule an apt. I get it I was last minute in trying to schedule.  All I needed was a new  wellness apt. because I was traveling this weekend with my puppy. Talk about acting like an elites Vet Spa, they don’t offer last minute cancellations calls. “Oh, we don’t call people for last minute apts…” As if she did not want my type of clientele.  My goodness, how judgemental.  I work in a customer service industry where we put new callers at a level of priority and we welcome potential patients with open arms.  But I guess this Vet spa elites facility does not need new pet comers.

I've been taking my cats to Lincoln Square Animal Hospital for over 15 years. Everyone (front desk staff, techs, vets)  is always kind, responsive, and professional. Dr. Czekala is amazing and has spent a lot of time with me and the critters over the years, patiently and honestly advising through various issues and ailments. I'm so grateful to have such quality and consistent care for my fur babies!

Lincoln Square Animal Hospital is outstanding!! They are super considerate and friendly and really dedicated to excellent animal care. We have a behaviorally challenging dog and they have been SO helpful with advice and coaching and the vibe on the phone and in person is so positive. Thanks for being so excellent!

This is not hyperbole - Lincoln's Square Animal Hospital saved my dog's life. On a routine appointment, they found an abnormal, aggressive cancerous tumor and referred me to a specialist. This was four years ago and she is still the best weirdo on this planet.

I made an appointment for my dog , hair Lost, back legs arthritis, and white spot on his right eye, my dog hasn't eaten for 2days his stomach is upset, the vet didn't give me any solution for the problems he is having, she recommended x-ray because his heart etc... did not solve any of the problems why we came for, i will take my dog for a 2nd opinion somewhere else,  do you think if I go to McDonald's and ask for a cheeseburger and they try to sell me some chicken nuggets I will take that, no one will this is the last time I bring my dog to this place you guys very unprofessional and try to charge for things that the dogs don't even need it , i research before going to the vet ,and what this "veterinary" recommend is not even close to the solutions for the problems i scheduled my dog for.

I am happy to take Lily to a wonderful, animal hospital near my home. Sometimes Lily don't like to go inside, but its her second home. LOL. Everyone highly professional and caring about Lily's health. Lily has been a patient for about 14 years.
Our dog Reggie actually begs and cries when we get close to the vet office here, because he LOVES the vets and techs here that much! Fair transparent pricing, and really good care. We love LSAH ❤️

First off, this place is a major rip-off as they have never really had any good solutions to issues that my German Shepherd has had.

Their answer is always we need to get X, Y, and Z done prior to discussing a root cause.   Make no mistake!  X, Y, and Z are ONLY there to ramp up your bill into the hundreds of dollars. Even the prescriptions are 2-3x what they would cost you at CVS or Walgreens.

Secondly, (the reason they have lost my business for good!) is the staff here discloses in-accurate information to 3rd party pet groomers without checking with their veterinarian first and most importantly, without the owner's consent.  Due to them, my dog had to suffer not being bathed after a issue with his paw that was almost entirely healed. The only way they make this situation right with me is to bathe my Shepherd themselves since they caused me a lot of time and upset.

Always great care and wonderful staff. We have been coming here for over 10 years! We have 2 cats and 1 dog and this veterinarian facility has always been here for us for the highs and the lows. Highly recommended.
Amazing standard of care. The people at the front desk are super helpful and kind. I always have a great experience here!
Vey nice people.

very friendly staff and my dog loves them! not sure how they compare in price to other vets but I pay about $200 for annual visits and vaccines and $500 when the 3 year vaccines come up too (not including trio which is about another $400 a year)

While my pet was alive, I had good experiences. However, about 4 years after they euthanized my pet they called to tell me I needed to pick up a paw print they made of my cat.

I did not ask them to make this, I do not know when they made it (I presume after death since I wasn’t aware of it), I was not contacted previously about it. We have now moved over 2.5 hours away and cannot come to get it.

I found their call bizarre and upsetting.
We have been taking our pets here for several years, and the vets and staff are all wonderful!!

I have been going here since their name used to be Jewell Animal Hospital. They have taken amazing care of both my cats and can rely on them to keep them happy and healthy. Customer service is really great and the staff is friendly.
These folks are great. So caring and empathetic, and Dr Czekala is fantastic. Can't recommend her, and the practice, enough.

The best vet in Chicago. Hands down.
Been going here since it was Jewell Animal Hospital and I’m happy to report that the new staff of doctors and staff has maintained the high level of service set forth by Dr. Jewell. Cannot recommend enough.

We’ve been taking our dog here for 2 years and could not ask for better care. Everyone, from the techs to the receptionists to the doctors, are A+. Their clinical staff is a cut above anywhere else we’ve ever been. Management is caring and understanding for payment. Our dog had two TPLO surgeries here and everything went even better than expected. We’re so thankful for Lincoln Square Animal!
Wonderful and helpful, compassionate is your brand. Thank you

TLDR; a good vet.

What’s not to love? The fantastic care we’ve received here dates back to when Dr Jewell opened it. We stuck through the transition and it’s gotten only better (although I do miss Dr Jewell’s bear hugs). They’ve invested in the clinic, grown the staff, and didn’t lose quality, care, or compassion along the way.

They’re responsive via email. They treat us and our pets like we’re a cohesive family. The exam rooms are clean and spacious, as is the waiting area.

We have a cat with some chronic issues and they’re just great in helping us manage them. He’s 16 and going strong thanks to them!

Vets always feel a little pricey (it’s not a flat rate co-pay!), but realistically, pricing is fair and I never feel surprised- they are good about discussing costs/options with us up front and they don’t make us feel guilty about skipping or delaying certain diagnostics to ease the blow.

Overall, our two humans, two cats, and single dog appreciate everything they do for us and we refer our friends.
Best team, super responsive and precious with our two dogs, Evie and Pearl! We love LSAH
I’ve been bringing my cats here for at least a decade and I have nothing but great things to say. Everyone from the vets to the front desk staff is super kind and helpful. They do a fantastic job.

I have been coming here for a few years. All of the vets and staff are very friendly, professional, and kind to my cat for her yearly checkups. It is also convenient that they do dental cleanings as well as yearly checkups. Fair pricing for services as well. The waiting room and rooms are clean. Overall, very happy I switched vets to them!

I've been taking my pets here for a few years now and have had nothing but good experiences! This week my cats had to have three follow-up visits three days in a row, and I really appreciated how accommodating they were at squeezing us into their packed schedule. Not only that, but everyone we encountered was so kind, patient and understanding of my questions and anxieties, and worked extra hard to make sure the cats had the most painless and comfortable time possible. They made what was an otherwise scary time so much easier and I'm so grateful!

Everyone (vet techs, front desk, veterinarian) at Lincoln Square Vet Hospital is caring, kind, and compassionate. Anytime I have a question about my pup, they are quick to respond and support us. I'm so grateful to have found a clinic so close by and so wonderful.

Lincoln Square Animal Hospital is fantastic! We have been bringing our pets here since 2010 and have always received incredible care and support. The team is compassionate and provides great guidance and support. Everyone there clearly has great expertise as well as a love and passion for animals. Definitely recommend them!

I always have a pleasant experience here. The staff is very friendly and explains everything to me. I’m blind so they take care of my guide dog and give her excellent care. Even though she whines about it every time we go. The only downside …
